build_pose_net: build a DLA pose estimation network with get_pose_net specifying num_layers, heads, and down_ratio
create_DLA_backbone: create a DLA backbone model using dla34 with pretrained ImageNet weights and custom input channels
create_BasicBlock: create a BasicBlock residual block with configurable inplanes, planes, stride, and dilation parameters
create_Bottleneck: create a Bottleneck residual block with 1x3x1 conv pattern and configurable expansion factor
create_IDAUp: create an IDAUp module with deformable convolutions for feature pyramid upsampling and fusion
